patches.find: 'peer aspect-square h-4 w-4 rounded-full border border-primary text-primary shadow focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50'
patches.replace: 'peer aspect-square h-4 w-4 rounded-full border-solid border-(length:--balsa-outline-border-width) border-primary text-primary shadow-[var(--balsa-shadow-control)] focus:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50'
patches.reason: Tailwind shadow utilities compile to literal offsets, so elevation cannot reach through a variable.

limitations: Control heights stay on the upstream scale; Balsa density is not a Tailwind grid unit.
Type scale stays on the upstream scale; Balsa defines no numeric type scale.
The Glass material is not applied; material direction is a composition decision.
